items.detail: Booked, party of five, customer ID AOT-BJ-James-50674. Sharing a twin with Jeff avoids the RMB 2,100 single supplement, which falls to Kamana or Alka instead.
Korean Air booking FAFD77, economy, one checked bag.
Confirmed with James on 16 August. Billed through the tour rather than separately.
China Eastern on Delta miles. Confirmation GBDPCB.
Seat 28A, confirmation G3LX5Q — the return half of the Trybal SoCal round trip, not a China purchase.
~$240 all in. ¥732 prepayment charged 27 Sep, balance at checkout.
Amex Brilliant free-night award, taxes included, nothing to pay.

Not booked — the last open bed. All five Disney-side at the Courtyard ITRZ is ~¥2,495 at ~¥499/night, plus a ¥180–250 Didi on arrival night because the last Line 11 train has gone by the time you clear Hongqiao. Split stay is one downtown night (¥300–500 at an Atour or Ji, or ¥1,500–2,500 at the Fairmont Peace) plus four at the Courtyard (~¥2,000), which cancels most of that taxi and puts you at the museum door on the Sunday. Going Ji or Atour on the park side instead would bring the whole five nights to ~¥1,300, at the cost of Platinum breakfast and an English-speaking front desk. Only the Courtyard figure is a verified live rate (Marriott, 10 Sep, your dates).

Mon 12, Tue 13, Wed 14 Oct. Cheapest route is a 2-Day ticket plus a 1-Day Early Bird, ~¥1,200 (~$170) against ¥1,449 buying singles at the gate. The optional Thursday morning adds a full 1-Day at ¥449–499, taking it to ~¥1,650–1,700. Dated tickets, not an annual pass — decided. No Premier Access budgeted: on three post-Golden-Week weekdays you shouldn't need it.
The separate Tang murals hall is a paid ¥270 ticket and a different booking — skip unless you especially want it.
¥45 for three hours, then ¥5 per extra ten minutes. Deposit is ¥100 in older sources and ¥200 in newer ones, so have ¥200 free.
Must carry a moulded 3C mark or it's confiscated at Lhasa. Xiaomi, Baseus or UGREEN.
Unavoidable: you land 21:50, bags clear ~22:20, and the last Line 11 with a change at Jiangsu Road goes ~22:30–23:00. ~50 km, 60–70 min. One-off, first night only.
Airport to hotel ~¥7–8 on Lines 14 and 4; Terracotta round trip ~¥9. Fares come off the ride code inside Alipay.
